title: Build your slide template
author: Martin Fowler (martin@martinfowler.com)
description: Building a slide template starts with three foundational choices — colours, fonts and layouts. Sumeet Gayathri Moghe covers the basics of color theory and how to build a reusable palette, the essentials of typography, including serif, sans-serif, handwritten and monospace fonts, plus the finer points of kerning and…
summary: Building a slide template starts with three foundational choices — colours, fonts and layouts.
